definitions.explanation: A reservation or booking made ahead of general availability, typically offered to members, fans, or priority customers before tickets or products go on sale to the public.

examples.japanese: {先行|せんこう}{予約|よやく}が{始|はじ}まった。
{会員|かいいん}{限定|げんてい}の{先行|せんこう}{予約|よやく}で{チケット|ちけっと}を{取|と}った。
examples.english: I got tickets through a members-only advance booking.

examples.japanese: {新作|しんさく}ゲームの{先行|せんこう}{予約|よやく}を{受|う}け{付|つ}けておりますので、お{早|はや}めにお{申|もう}し{込|こ}みください。
examples.english: We are accepting advance orders for the new game, so please apply early.

notes:
USAGE:
Common in entertainment (concert tickets, events) and retail (new product launches, limited editions). Often offered as a perk for fan club members or loyalty program participants.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {先行|せんこう}{予約|よやく}する (to pre-order / book in advance)
- {先行|せんこう}{予約|よやく}{受付|うけつけ} (advance booking reception)
- {先行|せんこう}{予約|よやく}{特典|とくてん} (advance booking bonus)
- {先行|せんこう}{予約|よやく}{開始|かいし} (start of advance bookings)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {予約|よやく}: reservation — the general term for any booking
- {先行|せんこう}{販売|はんばい}: advance sale — emphasizes the selling rather than the reserving
